title: Which city will be the site of Typhoon Dolphin's first landfall in mainland China in August 2026?
background: Dolphin developed into a typhoon over the Pacific in late July 2026.
resolution_criteria:
Source of Truth : Landfall information issued by China's meteorological authorities, either directly or through contemporaneous reliable news coverage. 
  Resolution Condition : Resolve to the city identified as the location of Dolphin's first mainland China landfall during August 2026. Offshore island landfalls do not count. 
  Accepted Answer Format : Provide the city name, rather than its province or a broader geographical region.
